text:
devon: Hey team — I'm debugging a customer regression where generated responses leak internal IDs. Need temporary access to the raw request/response payloads for a single user session to repro. Will not be used for analytics. 

maria: What's the exact scope and how long do you need it for? We prefer hashed ids vs raw. :eyes:

jonah: We can give a one-off signed S3 link to an ephemeral bucket (24h) or a time-limited Kibana view. Which do you need?

devon: Ephemeral S3 is fine. 24h should do it. Will scrub tokens and creds before uploading but need full prompt+response to see KV cache behavior.

security-bot: Automatic note: Access to raw LLM payloads requires approval from Eng Sec + App Owner and an explicit retention window. See https://redwood.internal/security-data-access for checklist.

maria: Approve if you promise: 1) delete after 24h, 2) mask any token-like strings, 3) annotate PR with evidence. Also add justification in the ticket.

anna: +1 from product side assuming minimal scope. Please redact customer PII where possible, and run on a non-prod copy.

sre-oncall: If you go S3, we'll create a pre-signed PUT with server-side encryption and bucket lifecycle to auto-delete after 1 day. Also recommend uploading only gzipped payloads to reduce footprint.

devon: Will follow those constraints. Here's the scrub filter I'll run before upload (simple regex-based):
```
filters:
  - name: mask_tokens
    pattern: '(?:Bearer\s+|token=)[A-Za-z0-9\-_.]+'
    replace: '[REDACTED_TOKEN]'
  - name: hash_user_id
    pattern: 'user_id=([0-9a-fA-F]{8,})'
    replace: 'user_id=HASH(<sha256>)'
```

maria: Regex looks ok but please add guard for long embeddings or file attachments. Also include a short review after you delete.

devon: Will do. Filed ticket: https://redwood.internal/infra/tickets/RE-4923 and opened PR with scrub script: https://git.redwood/infra/patches/1234. Requesting S3 link creation now.

jonah: Created pre-signed PUT: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-ephemeral/put/ABC123 (expires in 24h). s3 lifecycle set to 1 day. Sending ACL to devon via DM.

devon: Got it, uploading now. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maria: Leaving a note to audit this in next weekly security review.

security-bot: Access log: requestor=devon approvers=[maria,anna] retention=24h method=ephemeral-s3 id=acc-1842109999
